posts.text:
$hg $hgraf data says it can make plastics 50% more recyclable and reduce the use of it by 30%. 

This should be a massive global story.  But instead we are caught up in political battles and religious and ideological wars. 

I got to believe that as these contracts roll in the company will get the mainstream attention it deserves.  

How do you even put a value on reducing global plastic use by 30%, making products last 2-3x longer and be 50% more recyclable? 

Just this one set data points on one application is so damn huge it’s crazy.  The market hasn’t even begun to digest this.  

It’s like a biotech that announces they have a proven cure for cancer and all the data.  They are building out pharmaceutical production. And critics are all pointing to the lack of current revenue and past R&D expenses. 
lol 

It’s impossible to predict how big a following this company is about to get because of its plastics business.

On top of this there is huge potential in battery tech, super capacitors, actuators, coatings, concrete, lubricants, textiles.  On and on.  Craziest story I’ve ever come across.   No company I’ve ever heard of has a larger potential TAM (total addressable market)

Seriously… I cant think of one ever that could have more profound world changing potential.   Sorensen says they are gonna change the world.  I’m so ready to see the contracts roll in and him get the Nobel prize he deserves
